warning.titlePre: Land Rover Discovery D250 Timing Chain Wear
paragraphs: Discovery D250 engines with the Ingenium AJ200D 2.0-litre diesel — fitted across the D5/L462 generation — share the same timing chain pattern as other JLR Ingenium diesel models. We replace timing chain components, tensioners, injector seals and gaskets as standard on every AJ200D rebuild.

Note: given the Defender VRF's DC-DC converter finding on Ingenium MHEV variants, Discovery D5's mild-hybrid diesels likely carry the same risk — this has NOT been independently confirmed for Discovery specifically and should not be stated as fact until checked.
warning.source: Source: established specialist pattern, per G-BRF Land Rover Section 5. DC-DC converter caveat noted per VRF Section 2 — pending confirmation for Discovery specifically
